newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks lower in quiet trade ahead of CPI.
newsitem.headline: French stocks lower in quiet trade ahead of CPI.

text.p: French stocks lower in very quiet trade ahead of U.S. May consumer price report due at 1230 GMT.
* CAC-40 index down 12.89 points, or 0.46 percent, at session low of 2,782.98 at 1043 GMT
* CAC-40 June futures contract down seven at 2,778 points
* EU leaders' agreement announced on Monday seen as neutral for bourse. "Neither side (France or Germany) completely carried the day," a broker said.
After U.S. economic data, bourse will watch next for Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's keynote policy address on Thursday.
Little news seen driving the various equities sectors.
